pages.text: This build has playable item and world carriers.$(br2)$(li)Talismans inscribe Theorems or named Laboratory proofs.$(li)Sneak-use to inspect witnesses, catalysts, attributes, and budget.$(li)The field ledger now records Harmonic Correspondence through practice and The Rotated Horizon through exploration.

pages.title: Items
pages.text: $(li)The $(thing)Programmed Talisman$() opens the Rune Programmer.$(li)The $(thing)Rune Chalk$() selects anchor theorems and inscribes their proofs.$(li)The $(thing)Rune Anchor$() holds an inscription centered in the world.$(li)The $(thing)Field Ledger$() shows private progress and routes.$(li)A $(thing)Field Manuscript$() records a discovery without being consumed.
